parse.title: Troll Stronghold/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough== ===Starting out=== [[File:Troll Stronghold - Troll Country.png|thumb|350x350px]] {{Checklist|*Speak to [[Denulth]] directly South of the Burthorpe Teleport. {{Chat option|1How goes your fight with the trolls?|1Is there anything I can do to help?|1I'll get Godric back!}} *Follow the path to the stronghold. You can buy the climbing boots along the way from [[Tenzing]]. (Note: If you have completed The [[Easy Combat Achievements]] you can skip this section, including the fight with Dad, by teleporting with [[Ghommal's hilt 1]]) *Enter the arena and attempt to kill [[Dad]]. The fight will end before Dad is killed (can be safespotted from the gate; magic or a halberd are good choices due to his high range defence). *After nearly killing '''Dad''' exit the arena through the north gate. *Go through the cave and continue the path to the stronghold; [[Thrower troll]]s can be dealt with by: **Sprinting past them. **[[Protect from Missiles|Protecting from Missiles]] against them. **Taking agility shortcuts around them. *Enter the stronghold through the cave entrance.}} ===Stronghold Dungeon=== {{Checklist|*Follow the red path to [[Troll General]]. Kill one and loot the [[Prison key (Troll Stronghold)|prison key]]. (Can be safespotted with a halberd, magic, or a ranged weapon behind the counter) '''(Hardcore Ironmen beware! The general is aggressive and his max hit is 38)''' *Follow the green path to jail. *Pickpocket (30+ {{SCP|Thieving}}) or kill the sleeping [[Twig]] and [[Berry]] (this can be safespotted through the open cell doors either side of them), free '''both''' of the prisoners. *Teleport to [[Burthorpe]] with the [[games necklace]] OR follow them out the secret exit and once outside climb over the south-east rocks. *Talk to [[Dunstan]]. *'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
